quote_found: Table 2 reports “Live birth 35/88 (39.8) 56/91 (61.5) <.01.” The text reports: “Odds of a live birth was 2.1 (95% confidence interval 0.95–4.68) with a frozen ET compared with a fresh ET.”

what_is_wrong: The pooled RR, CI, heterogeneity, trial counts, and author-defined responder classification are reported, but the claim's per-transfer timing is wrong. The endpoint was live birth per randomized participant under ITT, not live birth conditional on an embryo transfer. Separately, the paper is internally inconsistent: it reports n=3,398 for the three high-responder live-birth studies despite stating that all four high-responder RCTs together contained only 2,010 patients; the claim does not resolve that source inconsistency.

The article reports 170 women dropped out or deviated from protocol, yet retained the randomized-group ITT comparison.
